# CMake configuration for the runtime's generated headers
#
# COPYRIGHT (c) 2026 The Fellowship of SML/NJ (https://smlnj.org)
# All rights reserved.
#
# Several of the runtime's headers are generated by running small C programs
# that inspect the target system.  The programs are compiled with the same
# definitions as the runtime, and so they must be able to run on the build machine; i.e.,
# cross compilation is not supported.
#
# The generated files are written to this directory's binary directory.
# This file also defines `smlnj-runtime-common`, the include path shared by
# all of the runtime code, which includes the generated files.
#

set(gen_dir ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})

# common support code for the generator programs
#
add_library(smlnj-gen-common OBJECT gen-common.c)
target_include_directories(smlnj-gen-common PUBLIC
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
  ${SMLNJ_RUNTIME_SOURCE_DIR}/include
  ${gen_dir})
target_link_libraries(smlnj-gen-common PUBLIC smlnj-runtime-defs)

# the table of Unix signals, which is shared by two of the generators
#
add_library(smlnj-gen-signal-table OBJECT unix-signals.c)
target_link_libraries(smlnj-gen-signal-table PUBLIC smlnj-gen-common)

# smlnj_add_generator(<program> <output> <source>... [DEPENDS <file>...])
#
# build the generator <program> and run it in the generated directory to
# produce <output>.  The DEPENDS files are generated headers that the
# program includes.
#
function(smlnj_add_generator prog output)
  cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 2 arg "" "" "DEPENDS")
  add_executable(${prog} ${arg_UNPARSED_ARGUMENTS} ${arg_DEPENDS})
  target_link_libraries(${prog} PRIVATE smlnj-gen-common)
  add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${gen_dir}/${output}
    COMMAND ${prog}
    DEPENDS ${prog}
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${gen_dir}
    COMMENT "Generating ${output}"
    VERBATIM)
endfunction()

smlnj_add_generator(smlnj-gen-sizes ml-sizes.h gen-sizes.c)

smlnj_add_generator(smlnj-gen-unix-signals system-signals.h gen-unix-signals.c)
target_link_libraries(smlnj-gen-unix-signals PRIVATE smlnj-gen-signal-table)

smlnj_add_generator(smlnj-gen-unix-sigtbl unix-sigtbl.c gen-unix-sigtbl.c)
target_link_libraries(smlnj-gen-unix-sigtbl PRIVATE smlnj-gen-signal-table)

smlnj_add_generator(smlnj-gen-offsets mlstate-offsets.h gen-offsets.c
  DEPENDS ${gen_dir}/ml-sizes.h ${gen_dir}/system-signals.h)

# unix-sigtbl.c is #include'd by mach-dep/unix-signal.c, not compiled
#
set(SMLNJ_GENERATED_FILES
  ${gen_dir}/ml-sizes.h
  ${gen_dir}/system-signals.h
  ${gen_dir}/unix-sigtbl.c
  ${gen_dir}/mlstate-offsets.h)

add_custom_target(smlnj-runtime-generated DEPENDS ${SMLNJ_GENERATED_FILES})

# the include path and definitions that are shared by all of the runtime
# code; its users are built after the generated files.  (The generator
# programs cannot use this target, since they produce the generated files.)
#
add_library(smlnj-runtime-common INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(smlnj-runtime-common INTERFACE
  ${gen_dir}
  ${SMLNJ_RUNTIME_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
target_link_libraries(smlnj-runtime-common INTERFACE smlnj-runtime-defs)
add_dependencies(smlnj-runtime-common smlnj-runtime-generated)
